Eruption from full HP in sun with STAB is super effective and should KO Torterra before it gets a second move. Torkoal's high Defense means it likely survives Torterra's first attack, making the trade favorable.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Torterra is Grass/Ground, super effective... wait, Fire is super effective on Grass. Eruption at full HP in sun with STAB would likely KO Torterra. But Torterra moves first and could kill Torkoal with Earthquake or Wood Hammer.

If Torterra has Earthquake, it would one-shot Torkoal probably. Torkoal defense176, Torterra attack up to 177. Earthquake is 100 BP... Torkoal is Fire type, neutral to Ground. 177 base HP with 176 Def should survive most Earthquakes probably. But it's risky.

Alternatively, switch to Venusaur - but Grass/Ground Torterra would just hit it with Earthquake too. Gholdengo resists... wait Gholdengo is Steel/Ghost, Ground hits Steel super effectively. Bad.

Eruption in sun at full HP would do massive damage. Torterra has decent SpDef but sun-boosted STAB Eruption 150 BP from137 SpA... in sun (1.5x) it's like 225 BP effective. Should KO most Torterras.

The question is whether Torkoal survives first. Torkoal is slow, Torterra likely faster. Torterra's best move is probably Earthquake or Wood Hammer/Stone Edge. Eruption power drops as HP decreases - even if it takes a hit, it may survive.

I'll go with eruption - it's super effective in sun and should KO if Torkoal survives.

Switching Venusaur in sun is strong: with Chlorophyll, it outspeeds. Venusaur resists Electric (Grass/Poison resists Electric 0.5x). Shadow Ball neutral. But it could get Will-O-Wisp.

Hmm, but the safest strong play given Chlorophyll Venusaur: switch. If Rotom Will-O-Wisps, Venusaur can Sleep Powder next turn outspeeding. Also Stealth Rock could be useful.

I think switching to Venusaur is best — good matchup, sun-boosted team, Chlorophyll speed.

Gholdengo doesn't like burn (reduces attack, irrelevant since special).

But Venusaur might take Will-O-Wisp; still fine.

Venusaur outspeeds Torkoal via Chlorophyll, and Mega Evolving grants Thick Fat to survive Torkoal's sun-boosted Fire attacks. Solarbeam is resisted by Fire, so Sludgebomb is the best neutral damage option to wear Torkoal down.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Venusaur with chlorophyll in sun is faster. Torkoal is Fire type, resists Grass. Sludgebomb is neutral, 90 BP. Solarbeam in sun is 120 BP but not very effective on Torkoal (Fire resists Grass) → effectively 60 BP. Sludgebomb better.

But Torkoal likely uses Eruption or Fire Spin... Venusaur can take a fire hit? Torkoal SpA 94-150, Eruption 150 BP in sun... Venusaur SpD 122, could be trouble. But we move first.

Mega evolve: Mega Venusaur has thicker fat ability - reduces fire damage by 50%. That's huge for taking a fire hit. So Sludgebomb [MEGA] is best.

Could also Growth +2 SpA in sun, but taking an Eruption at full HP Torkoal in sun is risky even with Thick Fat. Sludgebomb for damage now.

Actually consider: Sludgebomb 90 BP neutral vs Torkoal's SpD 81-134, Venusaur SpA 167 (mega ~167+). Might not KO. Torkoal then hits with Eruption. With Thick Fat, Venusaur survives easily. Then next turn another Sludgebomb KOs.

Growth would let next Sludgebomb KO but we take a full Eruption first without Thick Fat... no, mega evolves before move, so Thick Fat applies regardless. Growth [MEGA] then take Eruption (halved), then Sludgebomb +2 KOs. Hmm, that's also viable but slower.

Sludgebomb [MEGA] is safer and consistent.
